hints.title: Parity Invariant
hints.text: Collect all indices where s1 and s2 differ. Each operation changes the number of mismatches by 0 or 2. If the count of mismatches is odd, return -1.

hints.title: Two Matching Strategies
hints.text: Mismatches at diff[i] and diff[j] can be flipped together either via remote op 1 at cost x, or via adjacent flips at cost diff[j] - diff[i].

hints.title: Interval Dynamic Programming
hints.text: Use memoized interval search on mismatches dfs(i, j) taking the minimum of remote pair dfs(i+1, j-1) + x, adjacent left pair dfs(i+2, j) + diff[i+1] - diff[i], and adjacent right pair dfs(i, j-2) + diff[j] - diff[j-1].

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Memoized interval dynamic programming on mismatch indices.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedy local matching fails to balance between adjacent flip distances and remote fixed cost x.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Check parity first, then use interval dynamic programming to pair mismatched positions.
